title: Optimize set operation row keys
constraints: Preserve DISTINCT, UNION, INTERSECT, and EXCEPT row semantics
rationale: DISTINCT and set operations formatted full rows with format!("{:?}", row) to build string keys. Value already implements Hash and Eq, so Vec<Value> can be used directly as the set key without serializing rows to debug strings.
steps: Add a shared row deduplication helper using HashSet<Vec<Value>>
Reuse the helper for SELECT DISTINCT and set operation deduplication
Use HashSet<Vec<Value>> for INTERSECT and EXCEPT membership checks
Run focused DISTINCT and set operation regressions
expected_impact: Avoids repeated debug string allocation and formatting for row-level deduplication and membership checks.
